about: Operations dates offered in the rover planner. Built by scripts/build-ops-dates.mjs from the two snapshots in this folder. Do not edit by hand.

lightTime.query: Mars (499) observed from Earth geocentre (500@399), 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31, 1-day step, quantities 20 and 21
lightTime.limits: Geometry only. It does not say whether a launch or a transfer is feasible.

weather.provider: NASA/JPL-Caltech and Centro de Astrobiologia (CSIC-INTA), Curiosity REMS outreach feed
weather.limits: An outreach product, not calibrated science data. One place only: Gale Crater.
weather.seasonMatch: Each operations date borrows the Curiosity sol that falls a whole number of Mars years (686.973 Earth days each) earlier, or the nearest sol with temperatures within 5 days. This stand-in is the game's model, not a NASA forecast.

dates.note: Closest approach in the 2026 to 2030 record
